surfaces.name: 搜索
surfaces.adopted: 官方控件、旧页面及Loom查询绑定混合；搜索目标行和常用对象行由锁定官方源码生成，保留菜单焦点ref兼容接线；SearchOverlay原声明生成、官方Modal和searchOverlayAnchor直接依赖，删除内容隐式Vite别名；Loom提供固定overlay结果导航接线；MessageHitRow原声明生成（仅稳定键兼容补丁），searchGrouping纯函数直接依赖官方文件；最近会话/历史/常用对象/消息列分组/分页状态采用MessageSearchPage原JSX区块，TextLink直接依赖；原展示文件仅保留数据/状态/事件接线；输入栏/头部、五类筛选控件、首页/结果空态、结果骨架采用原JSX/声明，目录/输入法/路由仅本地控制器接线；已选筛选使用原生data-has-value；错误区使用官方 Banner warning 原件，保留查询和消息打开失败的真实原因及重试
retainedBoundaries: Loom owns query/permissions/bounded pagination and result routing. Native desktop-host search and unsupported incomplete-search remain omitted.

surfaces.name: 聊天（频道／单聊）
surfaces.adopted: 官方消息组件与构建时适配并存；悬浮工具栏/@提及/关注成员及成员行按锁定原件生成，composer输入与按钮组合提取原Composer子树；5处对应Vite改写移除，资料预览显式接入Loom；Timeline整模块原件加显式有界窗口补丁、ThreadPanel只读展示声明加Loom快照/页游标/操作槽生成，移除两处运行时改写及宿主类型强转；MessageItem正文渲染hook及搜索高亮声明按原件生成，Markdown AST token/修复/安全清洗及源位置对齐直接依赖锁定原件，删除旧正文正则预处理；共享MarkdownContent/CodeBlock/CustomProtocolLink/复制控件与AttachmentChip完整模块采用原件，仅重绑定import；MessageItem/MessageInput完整宿主及附件评论/预览外壳现在从锁定原件生成，移除对应Vite变换，旧入口仅桥接
retainedBoundaries: Loom owns channel/private-box/side authority, drafts, unknown-write reconciliation, bounded cursors and file roots.
Generated official presentation retains explicit identity/time/follower/task/comment bindings; upgrades require focused checks.

surfaces.name: 动态
surfaces.adopted: raft-ui InboxItem及Loom聚合/跳转接线；空状态原JSX提取，筛选语义绑定Loom；过滤栏原JSX提取（显式批量已读动作槽），ConversationAvatar原声明提取（本地最小身份输入类型）；保留已采用的新版紧凑InboxItem行，不回退旧版卡片；原生标题/计数/全部已读展示由原JSX生成，刷新动作slot和未知计数由Loom提供，失败采用官方Banner
retainedBoundaries: Loom owns durable read frontiers, paging, jump anchors and unknown-write protection.
Compact InboxItem is the adopted v1.21.26 resource port, not byte-exact public-source code; preview reuses migrated chat/thread presentation.

surfaces.name: 任务
surfaces.adopted: 官方任务组件、提取变换及本地任务状态绑定；TaskModalHead完整非导入声明生成、ShowMoreToggle原文件依赖，删除任务头部隐式Vite属性替换；看板列/分组列表/拖动包装及卡片原声明提取、显式Loom权限写入接线，VirtualizedTaskStack直接依赖，删除两条Vite变换及两处类型豁免；工具栏/页头/IdentityFilterChip/SelectionPopover、创建DialogCard与标题行、MainLayout任务外框/标题栏、属性与历史容器均从锁定原件直接依赖或生成；删除创建弹窗Vite临时改写，保留未知写入核实slot和冻结fieldset
retainedBoundaries: Loom owns five task states, permission checks, batch writes and history. Task messages reuse the migrated ThreadWorkspace.
Optional official view-thread control remains omitted where no route binding is supplied.

surfaces.name: Agent／Role
surfaces.adopted: 名称/属性行/时间线原声明提取，Role和实例轨迹共用官方LogItem；Role资料hero和identity布局按AgentDetailPanel原JSX提取，AvatarSlot/像素头像完整模块生成，保留角色/实例语义与默认资料入口
retainedBoundaries: Role configuration, frozen revisions, aggregate presence, instance lifecycle and activity filters are Loom semantics; official Agent stores are not adopted.

surfaces.name: 计算机
surfaces.adopted: 官方Header、KeyValueRow、完整AvatarListRow直接依赖；Loom保留计算机与实例身份、运行时数据和导航绑定；恢复官方仅手机设置入口，手机列表采用官方ListRow/IconTile组合；计算机资料hero/原生IconTile/状态徽标以及运行时属性容器均从MachineDetailPanel提取，真实状态标签与CLI清单由Loom注入
retainedBoundaries: Loom owns local host discovery/state, runtime inventory, revision-safe edits and instance associations. No cloud Computer control is enabled.

surfaces.name: 记忆
surfaces.adopted: Loom全局记忆语义，复用官方基础及关闭/标题组件
retainedBoundaries: Channel-scoped memory browsing/editing with revision and provenance checks is Loom-only; user approved activity-style cards and native primitives, not an upstream global memory page.

surfaces.name: 设置
surfaces.adopted: 外观声明和日期/时间JSX自动提取；主题选择器直接依赖；其他Tab仍混合；更新日志内容区块及分类规则自动提取，旧构建切片已删除；账户资料/通知/关于/系统频道采用锁定源码展示切片与显式兼容补丁，删除四条运行时改写；归档及恢复按钮/设置侧栏/表单已提取，panelBounds直接依赖官方；设置Panel/滚动正文按SettingsPanel原JSX生成，恢复canvas表面；AvatarSlot和像素资源进入锁定依赖
retainedBoundaries: Loom owns local settings routing, drafts and device preferences; usage/runtime management has no equivalent Raft cloud business owner.
Unsupported cloud account/billing/managed MCP controls remain omitted.

crossCutting.name: 顶栏／导航／分栏
retainedBoundaries: Loom owns route/history/responsive composition and single-workspace identity; official splitters and width hooks are direct dependencies.
Topbar frame/regions/search come from AppTopBar source; v1.21.26 adaptive width remains a documented resource port.

crossCutting.name: 附件／工作区文件
retainedBoundaries: Loom owns rooted reads/cancellation/bounds and HTML/PDF permissions; channel roots and Git view selectors are thin native primitive compositions.
Workspace frame/split panes/file header/image preview now come from AgentWorkspace; local Git diff stays bounded text, not official structured attachment diff.

crossCutting.name: Fork／Side／实例生命周期
retainedBoundaries: Fork/Side authority, lifecycle and read-only boundaries have no matching Raft business owner; use official scenario components without importing execution state.
